transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

Yeah… I’m here because things have been getting harder to handle at home. Ever since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been snapping at my wife over stupid little house things, and I’m putting off jobs and paperwork I used to keep up with.

And even when I try to get away from it—like going out to the workshop or trying to fish—I just can’t seem to get my head quiet. It’s been wearing on me.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that usually make you happy, like fishing or working in the shop?

Yeah, I guess so. I still go out to the workshop or try to fish, but it doesn’t really settle me down like it used to. My head just keeps going, mostly about stuff at home since my father-in-law moved in. So it’s not as enjoyable, no.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about things even when you try not to, or does your mind feel like it won’t slow down?

Yeah, my mind just won’t slow down. Even when I’m out in the workshop or trying to fish, I’m still thinking about everything at home. Since my father-in-law moved in, it’s like I can’t get any real quiet in my head.
Do you ever feel down or lose interest in things even when there isn’t a specific problem at home or stress with your father-in-law?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed that. It mostly seems tied to what’s going on at home. When things are calmer, I don’t think I feel that way for no reason.
Have you ever felt down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy even when there wasn’t any particular stress or problem going on at home?
Not really, no. I mean, everybody has off days, but I can’t think of times where I just lost interest for no reason. It seems like it’s connected to the stress at home.
Have you ever had periods where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble enjoying activities for more than just a day or two, even when there wasn’t any stress going on at home?

I don’t think so. Not that I can remember, anyway. If I’ve felt down or not enjoyed things, it’s usually been when things at home were tense. When that isn’t going on, I don’t really notice it lasting like that.
Have you ever had times when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of days when there wasn’t any specific problem or stress at home going on?

No, not really. It’s been pretty tied to the situation at home. Since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been snapping at my wife over little things around the house, putting off stuff I normally handle, and even when I try to get away to the workshop or go fishing, my head just won’t quiet down. But I can’t say it happens when there isn’t some stress going on.

Have you ever noticed yourself feeling down, losing interest in things, or having trouble enjoying activities for more than a few days when there wasn’t any stress or problem happening in your life at all?

No, I don’t think so. When I feel that way, it’s been tied to what’s going on at home. Ever since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been snapping at my wife over little things, putting off jobs and paperwork I used to handle, and even when I’m in the workshop or trying to fish, I can’t really get my head quiet.
